turn_text: I have to say that during the entire process, everything is very family-friendly, which for me and many of the new members who are coming in that have young families, that aspect is very helpful. It was one of the most special things I had done in my life was to be able to have my two young children sitting with me on the house floor when I was sworn in.

The speaker has young children who were present at the swearing-in ceremony.
The presence of the speaker's children during the swearing-in was emotionally significant to the speaker.
Other new members with young families find the family-friendly nature of the process helpful.
The speaker considers the moment of their children sitting with them on the house floor during the swearing-in to be among the most meaningful experiences of their life.
